The flywheel does not.') — matches strategy doc's explicit stance that 'core (M1-M6)... is a legitimate close' (line 509); for M7+ cohorts the flywheel/collaboration framing primes M7 without resolving it. Big Idea fidelity: instantiates the named differentiator 'agents building agents — M3 + M6 skill authoring' (content-strategy line 82/712) faithfully, and the mood contract 'practitioner fluency' (line 443) is honored at close. Mood doesn't resolve early: this is the final beat of the practitioner-fluency stage in the AE101 arc ('joyful creation → grounded competence → earned trust → curious readiness → learning through contrast → practitioner fluency', line 252) — nothing downstream in core to preempt; for M7+ cohorts the close does not oversell finality in a way that would steal M7's 'awe + ownership' mood. Minor non-blocking observation: the lecture's own maintainer block (Mood target section) labels the mood-arc name 'unleashed leverage' for M6's meta-frame end — that phrase does not appear in the current strategy doc, which names M6's mood as 'practitioner fluency' throughout; internal maintainer-note drift only, not visible to students, does not affect body fidelity.
